results.question: Скільки всього згадок у відгуках?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(f.mention_count) AS mentions FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f LIMIT 1000

results.question: Скільки унікальних відгуків було подано?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.feedback_id) AS feedback_count FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f LIMIT 1000

results.question: Яка частка негативних згадок по відділеннях?
results.sql: SELECT dep.department_name AS "department", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.is_negative) / SUM(f.mention_count), 1) AS negative_share FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_department AS dep ON dep.department_key = f.department_key GROUP BY dep.department_name ORDER BY "department" ASC LIMIT 1000

results.question: Яка середня тональність за класами тем?
results.sql: SELECT t.class_label AS "topic_class", ROUND(AVG(f.sentiment_score), 3) AS avg_sentiment FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_topic AS t ON t.topic_key = f.topic_key GROUP BY t.class_label ORDER BY "topic_class" ASC LIMIT 1000

results.question: Топ-5 підкласів тем за кількістю згадок
results.sql: SELECT t.topic_label AS "topic", SUM(f.mention_count) AS mentions FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_topic AS t ON t.topic_key = f.topic_key GROUP BY t.topic_label ORDER BY "mentions" DESC, "topic" ASC LIMIT 5

results.question: Яка середня тривалість очікування в Приймальному відділенні?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(f.wait_minutes), 1) AS avg_wait_minutes FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_department AS dep ON dep.department_key = f.department_key WHERE dep.department_name = 'Приймальне відділення' LIMIT 1000

results.question: Скільки критичних згадок було у 2026 році?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(f.is_critical) AS critical_mentions FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_date AS dd ON dd.date_key = f.date_key WHERE dd.year = 2026 LIMIT 1000

results.question: Покажи кількість згадок по каналах збору відгуків
results.sql: SELECT c.channel_name AS "channel", SUM(f.mention_count) AS mentions FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_channel AS c ON c.channel_key = f.channel_key GROUP BY c.channel_name ORDER BY "channel" ASC LIMIT 1000

results.question: Яка середня оцінка відгуків по кварталах?
results.sql: SELECT dd.quarter_label AS "quarter", ROUND(AVG(f.overall_rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_date AS dd ON dd.date_key = f.date_key GROUP BY dd.quarter_label ORDER BY "quarter" ASC LIMIT 1000

results.question: Яке відділення має найвищу частку негативних згадок?
results.sql: SELECT dep.department_name AS "department", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.is_negative) / SUM(f.mention_count), 1) AS negative_share FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_department AS dep ON dep.department_key = f.department_key GROUP BY dep.department_name ORDER BY "negative_share" DESC, "department" ASC LIMIT 1

results.question: Скільки згадок про безпеку ліків за 2025 рік?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(f.mention_count) AS mentions FROM fact_feedback_mention AS f JOIN dim_topic AS t ON t.topic_key = f.topic_key JOIN dim_date AS dd ON dd.date_key = f.date_key WHERE t.class_label = 'Лікування і безпека' AND t.topic_label = 'Безпека ліків' AND dd.year = 2025 LIMIT 1000
